data_fields.name: partial_keep_base
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 (keep chance for non-ore items on a partial stage)

data_fields.name: salvage_yield
data_fields.donor_constant: SalvageInto(material, qty) per item: chest.ron Linen 3; modular tool 1

best_idea: A gathering node is a zone row with a hardness and a drop interval; each hit adds damage on the row, a partial stage pays a chance-filtered drop, and the full break pays all.
decision_why: Keep hardness, interval and the partial-stage keep roll, but keep damage on the zone row (server state), clamp the keep chance, and drop voxel-block storage; the donor is GPL-3.0 so clean-room only.
acceptance: Server test on a copper node (hardness 3, interval 1): hits 1 and 2 pay only the kept subset (keep 0.5, ore 0.5 + 0.1 x skill level); hit 3 pays every drop with the miner as loot owner.
